answer_1.quote: We introduce a novel End-to-End GPT-based model OmniFlatten for full-duplex speech conversation. OmniFlatten is capable of effectively learning the complex behaviors inherent to natural conversations and facilitates human-like interactions with low latency.
answer_1.outputs: text and speech outputs in a full-duplex dialogue setting

answer_2.quote: For TTS evaluation, we use the model to generate speech tokens based on the input text, which are then synthesized into audio. We follow the experimental setup outlined in the CosyVoice paper: the synthesized audio is subsequently recognized using the Whisper-Large-V3 model and Paraformer-zh model, for English and Chinese datasets, respectively, and the resulting ASR transcripts are scored against the input text to compute Word Error Rate (WER) for English datasets and Character Error Rate (CER) for Chinese datasets.

answer_3.quote: Therefore, we evaluate the full-duplex dialogue capabilities of OmniFlatten, by prompting a competitive text LLM to evaluate the semantics of dialogues and assign a score on the predicted assistant response from the model after training on three-stream data.
methods: LLM scoring with a prompt on a scale of 1 to 10 points
